column23: Keystrike is built to prevent hackers from impersonating employees and migrating between machines towards the inner sanctum of the organization. The technology ensures that employee commands were physically made on their machine, not by an attacker with remote access to their computer. Keystrike automatically and cryptographically attests the authenticity of every keystroke, providing anti-hijacking guarantees with no friction and full privacy for the user.  The Keystrike technology derives from award-winning research by Ymir Vigfusson, Associate Professor at Emory University, USA.
